plain_language_definition: Unique ID for a fixed analysis-grid location.
allowed_values_or_range: 399674 unique eligible IDs; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Retained from the monthly source files and joined to locations on pixel_id.
notes_or_caveats: Primary row key is pixel_id-year-month. The Parquet extract has 56354034 rows and covers April 2013-December 2024.

plain_language_definition: Calendar year of the monthly record.
source_or_derivation: Retained from the annual monthly source files.
notes_or_caveats: 2013 coverage starts in April; all later years contain 12 months.

plain_language_definition: Calendar month of the monthly record.
allowed_values_or_range: 1-12; 2013 starts at month 4 (April).
source_or_derivation: Retained from the annual monthly source files.
notes_or_caveats: Together year and month identify the monthly observation date.

plain_language_definition: Monthly Normalized Difference Vegetation Index used as an indicator of vegetation greenness.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed nonmissing range -0.858487 to 0.884359.
missing_value_meaning: Missing means no valid NDVI value is stored for that location-month; not zero.
source_or_derivation: Retained from the annual monthly source files without filling or filtering.
notes_or_caveats: 448562 missing of 56354034 rows (0.796%); missing and low values are preserved. Supplied zero-as-NoData values were already converted to missing; this extraction adds no zero-value filter. No exact zero values occur in the eligible curated records.

plain_language_definition: Monthly daytime Landsat land-surface temperature; it is surface temperature rather than air temperature.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed nonmissing range -5.110618 to 64.736618 degrees Celsius.
missing_value_meaning: Missing means no LST value is stored for that location-month; not zero.
source_or_derivation: Retained from the annual monthly source files without filling or filtering.
notes_or_caveats: 3253595 missing of 56354034 rows (5.773%); derived from Landsat products.

plain_language_definition: Longitude of the nominal center of the analysis-grid location.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed range 54.2391539608 to 54.9139684014; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Joined from evergreen_locations.parquet on pixel_id.
notes_or_caveats: Longitude is passed first to the EPSG:32640 coordinate transformation.

plain_language_definition: Latitude of the nominal center of the analysis-grid location.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed range 24.1018439893 to 24.8637051813; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Joined from evergreen_locations.parquet on pixel_id.
notes_or_caveats: Together lon and lat identify the nominal center of an approximately 30 m analysis-grid location.

plain_language_definition: Projected easting coordinate.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed range 219444.1049 to 289083.8708; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32640 with pyproj and always_xy=True.
notes_or_caveats: The fixed tile-grid origin is (0, 0) in this coordinate system.

plain_language_definition: Projected northing coordinate.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed range 2667377.0961 to 2751696.3751; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Transformed from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32640 with pyproj and always_xy=True.
notes_or_caveats: The fixed tile-grid origin is (0, 0) in this coordinate system.

plain_language_definition: Column index of the fixed-origin 1-km tile.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 219-289; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: floor(easting_m / 1000), using origin x0=0.
notes_or_caveats: Mathematical floor is used.

plain_language_definition: Row index of the fixed-origin 1-km tile.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 2667-2751; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: floor(northing_m / 1000), using origin y0=0.
notes_or_caveats: Mathematical floor is used.

plain_language_definition: Combined 1-km tile column and row as col_row.
allowed_values_or_range: 2160 unique tile IDs; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: String formed from tile_col and tile_row separated by an underscore.
notes_or_caveats: Tile labels do not imply independence.

plain_language_definition: Column index of a block grouping four adjacent tile columns.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 54-72; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: floor(tile_col / 4).
notes_or_caveats: Provisional grouping; mathematical floor is used.

plain_language_definition: Row index of a block grouping four adjacent tile rows.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 666-687; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: floor(tile_row / 4).
notes_or_caveats: Provisional grouping; mathematical floor is used.

plain_language_definition: Combined 4-km block column and row as col_row.
allowed_values_or_range: 229 unique block IDs; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: String formed from block_col and block_row separated by an underscore.
notes_or_caveats: Provisional label only; a seeded subset is assigned spatial_test.

plain_language_definition: Number of non-missing NDVI months greater than 0.2 from April 2013 through December 2021.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 3-105; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Count computed from 2013-2021 source NDVI values; eligibility requires a count of at least 3.
notes_or_caveats: Repeated on each monthly row for the pixel; the labels CSV stores one copy per pixel.

plain_language_definition: Number of non-missing NDVI months from April 2013 through December 2021.
allowed_values_or_range: Observed integer range 103-105; no missing values.
source_or_derivation: Count computed from 2013-2021 source NDVI values.
notes_or_caveats: Repeated on each monthly row for the pixel along with eligibility and geographic labels.

plain_language_definition: Indicates whether the pixel belongs to a development or spatial-test block.
allowed_values_or_range: development or spatial_test; assigned consistently within each block.
source_or_derivation: All occupied block IDs are ranked using SHA-256 of a fixed version prefix, seed, and block ID; ceil(20% of occupied blocks) are spatial_test (46 of 229 in this run; default seed 42).
notes_or_caveats: No NDVI/LST outcome is used for assignment. Spatial-test LST must not be used for fitting or model choices. This seeded set is scattered, not contiguous; no buffer is applied.

plain_language_definition: Identifies the intended role of the observation's calendar period.
allowed_values_or_range: fit (2013-2021), validation (2022), or final_evaluation (2023-2024).
source_or_derivation: Derived from year.
notes_or_caveats: For spatial_test blocks this only identifies the time window; it does not permit the held-out LST to be used for fitting or model selection. Use analysis_role together with geographic_split.

plain_language_definition: Specifies the intended use after combining geographic and calendar assignments.
allowed_values_or_range: model_fit; model_validation; later_year_evaluation; unseen_area_test; reserved_unseen_area_2022; later_year_unseen_area_test.
source_or_derivation: Derived from geographic_split and calendar_role.
notes_or_caveats: Only development/model_fit rows may be used for fitting; do not use spatial-test LST to fit or choose models. Spatial tests should be evaluated after model choices are frozen.
